name: Mũi thuyền lộng gió
notes: Into the wind at the bow of a little ship at sunset, played by the shared grown-up couple (templates/_models: Grab3D's Casual Man and Casual Woman, CC0, with Quaternius's Universal Animation Library) in their own clothes, with a red polka-dot kerchief knotted at his collar and a sky-blue bow in her hair, both built in crew.js; they are fitted a little smaller than on other cards (him .27 card widths tall) so that the little ship holds them, and its rail, wheel and cabin are raised to their height. The rest is built in code: a sky page that folds up (golden hour, a dusk painted over it, a big sun that sinks behind the far sea), a sea of swells rolling past with foam at the bow, the ship (hull with portholes, deck, rail, a step at the bow, a mast with flag, lantern and bunting, a cabin with a wheel, a lifebuoy, an anchor), gulls, dolphins and wind streaks. Stop 1: she looks out from the bow rail while he steers; a gull lands on the wheel and he salutes it, tiptoes up behind her and ties his kerchief over her eyes; she jumps and laughs, he whispers at her side, and a gust spins the tag on the mast round to show the card's first words (slot note1). Stop 2: he leads her to the bow and lifts her onto the step; she pulls the kerchief off and spreads her arms into the wind, the kerchief streaming from her hand, his hands at her waist; dolphins leap alongside, and a page of the ship's log with the card's photo and caption (slot caption) blows in and is pegged to the mast. Stop 3: she lets the kerchief fly off to the sunset, steps down and turns to him; they kiss as the sun slips into the sea, the sky turns rose and violet, stars come out, the lantern lights, and two gulls fly in a banner with the last words (slot note2). The next tap opens the letter. The act is the shared templates/_acts/lovestory.js; this card's own moves are in scenery.js, crew.js and story.js.
